Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/actitudes-de-la-juventud-en-espana-hacia-el-emprendimiento (the dictionary URL). Microdata https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1555236/MD2938.zip (as cached in batch_474 under .cache/spain_2012_entrepreneurship_barriers/, copied to .cache/spain_2012_entrepreneurship_economy/): DA2938 (fixed-width data, sha256 7be9f21a9b43ff00c08d1088457d151d153fbca90bfa9da5439429bc4761d98c), ES2938 (SPSS syntax), questionnaire cues2938pdf.pdf (scanned image PDF, sha256 0508aba3bca88c51e6e856349d2b483cf62a11e18f9f0c4ebee42ac27cfef019; P.4 and P.5 at the foot of the left column of page 1 of 8), marginals Es2938pdf.pdf (PREGUNTA 4, PREGUNTA 5). Processing script data/spain_2012_entrepreneurship.do, Bookmark 1: economy. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=paper_explicit, not data_labels: ES2938 carries NO variable labels for P4/P5 (0 VARIABLE LABEL entries; only the value labels '/p4 p5 1 Mejor 2 Igual 3 Peor 8 N.S. 9 N.C.'), so the words do not come from the data file. Code derivation is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do's infix reads p4 at col 38 and p5 at col 39 (= ES2938 DATA LIST 'P3 TO P5 37-39') and Bookmark 1 sets item = the literal names p4 p5, so the IRW code IS the CIS variable name; the questionnaire prints P.4 with column marker (38) and P.5 with (39), and the marginals label them PREGUNTA 4 / PREGUNTA 5, so the code-to-text tie is an explicit number/column match in CIS's own study materials. Step 5b VERIFIED anyway (verify_spain_2012_entrepreneurship_economy.R, VERDICT: PASS): live item x resp counts p4 42/506/854, p5 240/523/554 equal the published marginals for PREGUNTA 4 (Mejor 42, Igual 506, Peor 854, N.S. 35) and PREGUNTA 5 (240/523/554, N.S. 119, N.C. 1) cell for cell; a p4<->p5 swap fails every cell. Rebuilding from DA2938 cols 38/39 with the .do logic (8/9 dropped) reproduces the live table exactly: 2719 rows, 0/0 id-item-resp set differences; 1417 ids. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (2 items, resp 1..3). text_source=study_materials: item_text = P.4 and P.5 read visually from the questionnaire image (page 1 rendered at 200 dpi, no OCR engine) and confirmed as exact substrings of the Es2938pdf.pdf marginals text layer (asserted in .cache/spain_2012_entrepreneurship_economy/build.R); the leading 'Y, ' (And) is literal -- both questions follow on from P.3 -- and is kept. Not reproducible in CSV: the questionnaire underlines 'hace un año' (P.4) and 'dentro de un año' (P.5) for emphasis; the underline is dropped, the words are unchanged. 'P.4'/'P.5' numbers and column markers not shipped. instructions and section_prompt blank: each item is a self-contained question with no shared lead-in; single trivial section. option_text = ES2938 value labels 1 Mejor, 2 Igual, 3 Peor, identical to the questionnaire's printed options (asserted). RESP: CIS codes stored unchanged, 1 = Mejor (better), 2 = Igual (the same), 3 = Peor (worse), so higher = more pessimistic; N.S./N.C. dropped by the .do (p4 35 N.S.; p5 119 N.S. + 1 N.C., 8.3% of 1437); no filter, asked of all respondents. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 2938 in Spanish only, so item_text_translated and option_text_translated were written by IRW; an issues-page entry is owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Retrospective and prospective evaluation of the national economic situation' matches P.4 (retrospective) and P.5 (prospective); no mismatch. Content note: the two items are one retrospective and one prospective judgement on a shared mejor/igual/peor scale, paired by the .do into a two-item table; P.3 (the 5-point current-situation rating) is not in this table. SIBLINGS: none touched (education and friends are in-flight in batch_475 by other agents; barriers shipped in batch_474). RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow; Ben 2026-09-22, widened to every CIS survey year 2026-09-23, irw#2381); the questionnaire is CIS's own document. No register row written.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only; resp runs 1 = 'Mejor' (better), 2 = 'Igual' (the same), 3 = 'Peor' (worse), and 'don't know' answers (8% on p5) were dropped to missing by the IRW processing script.
